battle.name: 烏干達-坦桑尼亞戰爭
battle.brief: 烏干達-坦桑尼亞戰爭是中文維基戰爭列表所列的1978年衝突，烏干達越境進入坦桑尼亞卡蓋拉地區，雙方在邊境據點及道路交戰。坦桑尼亞地面力量使用中國Type 59中型坦克，此型車於1959年已在中國人民解放軍服役，屬裝甲部隊作戰裝備。

kit.name: 59式中型坦克
kit.history: 中國人民解放軍機械化步兵師與裝甲師的主力中型坦克，承擔機動作戰、火力支援及反裝甲任務，並作為友好國家裝甲部隊的制式裝備。

countries: 這場戰爭的地理主軸，是維多利亞湖東岸的卡蓋拉河邊境，以及由坦桑尼亞西北部通往烏干達西南部的走廊。姆萬扎、穆圖庫拉、布科巴、魯昆吉里、姆巴拉拉、卡巴萊、堡壘門、恩特貝與坎帕拉，構成戰役由西向東推進的 主要道路與補給節點。交戰雙方一方是由姆萬扎及布科巴方向展開作戰的坦桑尼亞人民國防軍，另一方是最初越過卡蓋拉河進入坦桑尼亞、其後依托烏干達西部城鎮防守的烏干達軍隊。贊比亞不是主要陸戰交戰方，但提供空軍與政治支援，使坦方能從西側牽制烏軍。坎帕拉雖距邊境較遠，卻因它是烏軍西部戰區的後方中樞而成為雙方必爭之地。
countriesEn: The geographical axis of the war ran along the Kagera River border beside Lake Victoria and along the corridor leading from northwestern Tanzania into southwestern Uganda. Mwanza, Mutukula, Bukoba, Rukungiri, Mbarara, Kabale, Fort Portal, Entebbe, and Kampala formed the principal road and supply nodes of an operation generally advancing from west to east. One belligerent was the Tanzanian People's Defence Force, operating from the Mwanza and Bukoba directions. The other was the Ugandan army, which initially crossed the Kagera River into Tanzania and later defended positions around the western towns of Uganda. Zambia was not a principal ground belligerent, but it provided air support and political backing, allowing Tanzanian forces to apply pressure from the western side. Although Kampala lay some distance beyond the frontier, it was the logistical center behind the Ugandan western operations and therefore became indispensable to both sides.
people: 艾達·艾敏既是烏干達總統，也是武裝力量最高指揮者；他已自任陸軍元帥，直接決定向鄰國用兵及集中西部兵力。坦桑尼亞總統朱利葉斯·克洛維爾·尼埃雷把迫使艾敏下台列為政治目標，不過坦方戰地最高指揮通常被戰史列為約瑟夫·基戈尼亞將軍，他負責協調最初攻勢與後續縱隊。烏方第四師指揮沙班·奧皮約少將負責西部主要戰區，但随着部隊離逃、指揮關係鬆散，其協調能力迅速下降。贊比亞總統肯尼思·卡翁達批准跨境航空支援，與坦方形成作戰配合。艾敏出走後，流亡政治領袖優素福·盧萊及戈德貝拉·姆旺加先後成為新政權核心；鐵托則在戰役末期收留艾敏。這些政治人物介入的是國家決策與戰後安排，真正執行 Tactical 指揮者則是雙方陸軍指揮官。
peopleEn: Idi Amin was both president of Uganda and commander in chief of its armed forces. Having proclaimed himself field marshal, he personally decided to use force against a neighboring state and to concentrate Uganda's western forces. Tanzanian president Julius Klover Nyerere made the removal of Amin a political objective, although General Joseph Kigonya is generally identified in campaign histories as the principal Tanzanian field commander responsible for coordinating the initial attack and the later columns. Major General Shaban Opiyo commanded Uganda's Fourth Division in the main western theater, but his ability to coordinate declined rapidly as units deserted and command relations loosened. Zambian president Kenneth Kaunda authorized cross-border air support in cooperation with Tanzania. After Amin left Uganda, the exiled political leaders Yusuf Lule and Godbera Mwanga successively became central to the new government, while Tito provided refuge to Amin near the end of the episode. These political figures shaped state decisions and the postwar settlement; actual tactical command remained in the hands of the armies' professional commanders.
kits: 截至1978年，坦方確有中國製Type 59主戰戰車，其主砲為100公釐，另有12.7公釐機槍；烏方西部序列則可見蘇聯製T-34-85及T-54、T-55戰車，分別使用85公釐與115公釐砲彈。坦方122公厘Type 204榴砲及烏方122公厘D-30式榴砲都是當時已列裝的火砲體系，82公厘迫擊砲、PKM通用機槍、AK-47或AKM步槍、RPG-7火箭筒及DShK重機槍則構成兩軍基層火力。開戰初期有坦方福加CM.11輕型噴氣機執行低空近距支援的記錄，贊比亞MiG-21則負責較高空的攻擊與掩護，但各機出擊架次及命中效果並不完整。彈藥消耗方面可確認口徑和供應來源，卻沒有可靠資料可列出各型剩餘量。Type 59所需柴油、100公厘砲彈、122公厘砲彈及備件，均須經公路與轉運維持，不能只按戰車出動數推算實際作戰週轉。
kitsEn: By 1978, Tanzania genuinely fielded Chinese Type 59 main battle tanks with a 100 mm gun and a 12.7 mm machine gun, while photographs and records of the Ugandan western order of battle show Soviet T-34-85, T-54, and T-55 tanks using 85 mm and 115 mm ammunition. Tanzania's 122 mm Type 204 howitzers and Uganda's 122 mm D-30 howitzers belonged to artillery systems already in service at the time. An 82 mm mortar, PKM general-purpose machine gun, AK-47 or AKM rifle, RPG-7 launcher, and DShK heavy machine gun formed the basic infantry firepower of both armies. Records place Tanzanian Fouga CM.11 jet aircraft in low-level close-support work during the opening phase, while Zambian MiG-21s provided higher-altitude attack and cover, although the sortie counts and effects were not fully documented. Calibers and supply origins can be established with confidence, but reliable figures for remaining ammunition stocks are unavailable. Diesel fuel, 100 mm tank rounds, 122 mm projectiles, and spare parts for the Type 59 had to be sustained by road and transfer services; operational turnover cannot be calculated merely from the number of tanks dispatched.
tactics: 1978年10月30日夜至31日，駐紮烏干達西南邊境的部隊越過卡蓋拉河，攻取穆圖庫拉附近據點，並沿公路向姆萬扎方向探進；坦方地方邊防營先以觀察哨、封鎖路口及分散撤退阻止其擴張，再集中砲兵與戰車反擊。11月1日至3日，穆圖庫拉一帶反覆易手，最後由坦方控制邊境據點，烏方退回河對岸。進入11月後，戰線沿卡蓋拉河固定下來，雙方以河川渡口、公路側翼、砲兵陣地和巡邏隊反覆交戰，坦方則從姆萬扎及布科巴方向補充師級部隊。1979年2月22日前後，坦軍以多點渡河及步兵密集突擊突破邊防，中央縱隊經魯昆吉里向姆巴拉拉推進，另一縱隊經卡巴萊、堡壘門方向切斷烏軍後路；以基桑加支隊為核心的機動分隊則繞開部分受阻路段，迅速向恩特貝及坎帕拉西側推進。烏軍在姆巴拉拉失守後失去成建制防守節點，坦軍因道路泥濘、燃料與後方縱隊距離而不能全速追擊。4月底，坦軍已進入坎帕拉外圍；艾敏於4月13日先赴利比亞，5月4日短暫返國後再次離開。5月3日，坦軍進入坎帕拉，但納基武布、金亞、穆科諾及坎帕拉周邊仍有烏方據點作戰。坦方進行有限的城市清剿後，於6月初開始分批撤退，戰役沒有演變成長期軍事占領。
tacticsEn: On the night of 30 October and during 31 October 1978, Uganda's western border force crossed the Kagera River, seized positions around Mutukula, and pushed along the road toward Mwanza. Tanzanian local defense battalions initially delayed the advance with observation posts, blocked junctions, and dispersed withdrawals before concentrating artillery and tanks for a counterattack. Mutukula changed hands repeatedly from 1 to 3 November, after which Tanzania held the frontier positions and Uganda withdrew across the river. During November the front stabilized along the Kagera, with both sides fighting over crossings, road flanks, gun positions, and patrols while Tanzania reinforced the western theater from Mwanza and Bukoba. Around 22 February 1979, Tanzanian forces broke through by crossing at several points and concentrating infantry for repeated attacks. The central column advanced through Rukungiri toward Mbarara, while another force pressed through Kabale and Fort Portal to threaten Uganda's rear routes. A mobile group centered on the Kisanga Brigade bypassed blocked sections and moved rapidly toward Entebbe and western Kampala. After Mbarara fell, the Ugandan army lost its principal coherent defense node, but Tanzanian pursuit was limited by mud, fuel supply, and the distance behind the leading columns. By late April the Tanzanian force was outside Kampala. Amin left for Libya on 13 April and briefly returned on 4 May before departing again. Tanzanian troops entered Kampala on 3 May, although Ugandan positions around Nakivubo, Jinja, Mukono, and the metropolitan perimeter continued to resist. After limited clearing operations, Tanzania began a phased withdrawal in early June rather than converting the campaign into a prolonged military occupation.
data: 可核對的時間節點如下：10月30日至31日是烏方越境與坦方反攻的起點，11月1日至3日為穆圖庫拉戰鬥，11月至翌年2月主要是卡蓋拉河沿線的消耗戰，2月22日前後展開總攻，2月底至3月上旬姆巴拉拉控制權轉移，4月13日艾敏首次離境，4月底坦軍威脅坎帕拉西側，5月3日坦軍進入首都，5月至6月初則處理納基武布、金亞及坎帕拉外圍的零散抵抗。公開作戰序列常列坦方第二十三、第二十五、第二十六步兵師等部，以及後來集中使用的基桑加支隊；烏方則以第四師、第九師和第十一旅等部為主。不同戰史因增援、臨時編組及指揮隸屬變動，對兵力和營級配置並不一致。坦方初期投入數千人的邊防攻勢，攻入烏境後常被概括為一萬至兩萬兵力；烏方西部可用兵力則多被估在數千至一萬餘之間。物資由達累斯薩拉姆經公路送到姆萬扎，再以卡車、渡船及河上轉運接上布科巴與前線。兩軍傷亡總數沒有完整且一致的原始統計，本實錄因此不列出任何精確死亡、重傷或失聯人數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology is as follows: 30 to 31 October marked the Ugandan crossing and Tanzanian counterattack; 1 to 3 November saw the fighting for Mutukula; November through February consisted mainly of attritional combat along the Kagera; a general offensive opened around 22 February; control of Mbarara shifted between late February and early March; Amin first left the country on 13 April; Tanzanian forces threatened western Kampala by late April; Tanzanian troops entered the capital on 3 May; and isolated resistance around Nakivubo, Jinja, and the metropolitan perimeter continued through May and early June. Published orders of battle commonly identify Tanzanian 23rd, 25th, and 26th Infantry Divisions and other formations, together with the later concentration of the Kisanga Brigade. Uganda's western force was built around the Fourth and Ninth Divisions and the Eleventh Brigade, among others. Histories differ over strength and battalion-level assignments because of reinforcements, temporary groupings, and changes in command. The initial Tanzanian border assault involved several thousand troops, while forces committed before the advance on Kampala are commonly summarized as between 10,000 and 20,000; available Ugandan western strength is usually estimated from several thousand to somewhat over 10,000. Supplies moved by road from Dar es Salaam to Mwanza, then by truck, ferry, and river transfer toward Bukoba and the front. No complete, consistent original totals exist for killed, wounded, or missing on either side, so this account quotes no exact casualty figure.
cause: 衝突根源不是單一邊界測量錯誤，而是邊界問題、艾敏政權與尼埃雷的敵對，以及雙方軍事互信崩潰的累積結果。卡蓋拉河部分河段與附近島嶼在殖民時期留下的界線並不完全清楚，河道變化和兩國實際控制也曾造成爭議。1971年艾敏掌權後，支持烏干達流亡政治及武裝力量的尼埃雷與艾敏逐漸決裂；艾敏方面指控坦桑尼亞庇護反對者，坦方則要求停止跨境支持與邊境軍事挑釁。1978年，烏軍駐防分散、士氣不穩和指揮問題已使艾敏急於用一次邊境行動扭轉局勢，遂批准向坦方進攻。坦桑尼亞則把這次進攻視為無法再容忍的威脅，並把迫使艾敏下台列為公開目標。贊比亞的加入不是新產生的基本原因，而是區域國家共同支持反艾敏行動的結果。
causeEn: The conflict did not arise from one isolated surveying error. It was the accumulated result of a frontier dispute, the enmity between Amin's government and Nyerere, and the collapse of military trust between the two states. Sections of the Kagera River and nearby islands had inherited ambiguous colonial boundary arrangements, while changes in the rivercourse and actual control had created further friction. After Amin came to power in 1971, his relationship with Nyerere deteriorated because Nyerere supported Ugandan exiled political and armed groups. Amin's side accused Tanzania of sheltering opponents, while Tanzania demanded an end to cross-border support and military provocation. By 1978, poor deployment, declining cohesion, and command problems made Amin anxious to reverse his position through a limited border operation, leading him to approve the attack into Tanzania. Tanzania treated the move as an intolerable threat and openly made the removal of Amin a political objective. Zambia's involvement was not the original cause but the result of a regional alignment supporting the action against Amin.
impact: 最直接的軍事影響，是烏干達西部野戰部隊失去完整作戰能力。第四師及第九師等部在邊境退卻、指揮崩解與部隊轉向之後，無法重新組成有效防線，首都與西部後方因此直接暴露於坦軍推進之下。艾敏政府的政治控制也在戰爭最後階段解體，坦軍進入坎帕拉後，支持流亡政治組合的新政府逐步接替舊政權。這場勝利提高了坦桑尼亞在維多利亞湖區的軍事投射能力，也顯示贊比亞能以航空支援介入鄰國衝突；但坦方沒有合併烏干達或永久控制卡蓋拉河，也沒有以戰爭正式解決全部邊界問題。烏干達軍隊雖遭重創，新政府後來仍須整编、補充裝備並處理不同軍事派系，顯示推翻艾敏不等於軍隊問題立即消失。兩國因此獲得共同的安全經驗，卻未因此建立能自動防止下一次邊境摩擦的機制。
impactEn: The most direct military effect was the loss of coherent combat power by Uganda's western field forces. After the withdrawal from the frontier, the breakdown of command, and growing desertions, formations such as the Fourth and Ninth Divisions could no longer reconstruct an effective defensive line, leaving the capital and western rear areas exposed to Tanzanian advance. Amin's political control also disintegrated during the final phase. After Tanzanian forces entered Kampala, a new government supported by exiled political factions progressively replaced the old regime. The campaign increased Tanzania's ability to project military power around the Lake Victoria region and demonstrated that Zambia could intervene in a neighboring conflict through air support. Tanzania nevertheless did not annex Uganda, establish permanent control of the Kagera River, or formally settle every boundary issue through force. Although the Ugandan army was badly weakened, the new government still had to reorganize formations, replace equipment, and manage competing military factions. The fall of Amin therefore did not instantly solve the armed forces' institutional problems. The two states gained a shared security experience, but that experience did not create a mechanism capable of automatically preventing another frontier dispute.
result: 戰術上，坦桑尼亞在穆圖庫拉、姆巴拉拉及通往坎帕拉的西部走廊取得主動權，最終迫使烏方主力放棄完整陣地；五月三日進入坎帕拉後，又逐步處理納基武布與周邊據點。政治上，艾敏第一次出國後雖短暫返回，五月初卻永久失去國內控制權，優素福·盧萊及戈德貝拉·姆旺加先後進入新政權。坦方沒有另建長期占领政府，也沒有吞併烏干達國土；六月三日戰役通常被視為結束日期之後，部隊分批撤出，至六月上旬才完成主要離境行動。卡蓋拉河沿線的實際控制大致回復戰前狀態，邊界爭議則沒有因這次戰爭而全部解決。因此，結果是坦桑尼亞完成有限政治與軍事目標、烏干達舊政府垮台，而坦軍最終退出，而不是一方永久消滅另一方軍隊或取得永久領土。
resultEn: Tactically, Tanzania gained the initiative at Mutukula and Mbarara and along the western corridor to Kampala, eventually forcing the principal Ugandan formations to give up coherent positions. After entering Kampala on 3 May, Tanzanian forces progressively reduced the remaining positions at Nakivubo and around the metropolitan area. Politically, although Amin briefly returned after leaving the country for the first time, he permanently lost domestic control in early May. Yusuf Lule and Godbera Mwanga subsequently entered the new government. Tanzania did not establish a prolonged occupation government or annex Ugandan territory. After 3 June, conventionally treated as the end of the war, its forces withdrew in phases, with the principal departure completed during early June. Actual control along the Kagera broadly returned to the prewar pattern, and the war did not fully resolve every boundary dispute. The result was therefore a limited Tanzanian political and military objective achieved, the collapse of Amin's government, and a Tanzanian withdrawal, rather than the permanent destruction of one army or the acquisition of lasting territory.
